How to deal with emotional overload, hate, and the kind of perfectionism that can destroy even the greatest careers. We also discussed what really lies behind the records, the titles, and the millions in prize money: fear, exhaustion, learning from mistakes, or the self-awareness it takes to stay at the top.

This episode is about the mindset of a champion. About the inner system that helps you stay at the top when everyone else burns out under the pressure.
